title: Casual Items
description: A simple Minecraft mod that includes various items that can be useful for roleplaying and building.
body: CasualItems is a Minecraft mod that adds a collection of real-world tech and gaming-themed items, such as iPhones, Samsung phones, AirPods, Wiimotes, Nunchucks, AC remotes, and game discs that play music. It also includes decorative props like charging cables and a placeable Samsung TV. These items serve primarily as collectibles, decorations, or light audio features, adding humor, nostalgia, and a modern touch to your Minecraft experience perfect mostly for roleplaying.
